notes: STALENESS: `cases` is a curated, hand-annotated subset (194 entries) captured while db_ops still lived at tools/db_ops inside dba-runbooks. Its per-case `file` paths carry that old prefix. `total_cases` and `collected_files` are the CURRENT full collection, refreshed 2026-08-06; the two numbers are meant to differ.

The business_capability / production_risk_covered annotations are written by hand, so this file is not regenerated wholesale from --collect-only. Extend `cases` when a new test covers a production risk that no listed case covers; the suite itself is the authority on what runs.
Design-gap tests are marked pytest.mark.xfail(strict=True), so the regression suite stays green while preserving explicit coverage for missing durable lock/scope design.
Do not make xfail tests pass by weakening assertions; make them pass by implementing the documented production design.
